t.why: One of Africa's largest oil producers and the leader of ECOWAS. It is fighting Boko Haram in the northeast.
t.rel: It borders Benin, Niger, Chad and Cameroon. With the countries around Lake Chad it formed a multinational force against armed groups such as Boko Haram. It disputed the Bakassi Peninsula with Cameroon and handed it over after an International Court of Justice ruling.
t.korea: Korean construction companies have built gas and power plants there.
t.know: Nollywood ranks among the world's top film industries by the number of films made each year.
t.etext: Oil and gas make up most exports. As Africa's most populous country, domestic industries such as film, music and fintech are big too. A falling currency and high inflation are a burden.
